The **Assault Rifle** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*.

Fed from a side-mounted magazine, the M199 assault rifle has anti-aircraft (AA) style sights and interchangeable barrels and magazines. [1] [Pub 1] It includes a charging handle on the right fashioned out of wood. In Appalachia, the assault rifle is used by Scorched, Raiders, Settlers, and Super Mutants.

The Assault Rifle features a side-mounted magazine and fires 5.56 Rounds. If fitted with an automatic receiver, the rifle switches to using Center Masochist perks instead of Down Ranger.
